name: Cherrapunji & Dawki
description: Famous for spectacular waterfalls, limestone caves, crystal clear Umngot River in Dawki, and bio-engineered Living Root Bridges.

name: Tawang & Ziro Valley
description: Home to the majestic 400-year-old Tawang Monastery, snow-clad Sela Pass, and the lush UNESCO-tentative Ziro Valley.

name: Nathula Pass & Gurudongmar Lake
description: Breathtaking high-altitude lakes at 17,800 feet surrounded by sacred snow peaks and historic Silk Route passes.

name: Kaziranga & Majuli Island
description: World UNESCO sanctuary for the One-Horned Rhinoceros and Majuli, the world's largest inhabited river island.

name: Dzukou Valley & Kohima
description: Known as the Valley of Flowers of the East, boasting emerald rolling hills, rich Naga tribal culture, and Hornbill heritage.

name: Reiek Peak & Blue Mountain
description: Serene hill stations overlooking deep valleys, Phawngpui Blue Mountain Peak, and peaceful heritage villages.

name: Loktak Lake & Keibul Lamjao
description: The largest freshwater lake in Northeast India, featuring unique floating islands (Phumdis) and the endangered Sangai deer.

name: Ujjayanta Palace & Unakoti
description: Stunning Neoclassical royal palaces and Unakoti's ancient 7th-century bas-relief rock carvings carved into hillside cliffs.
